title: Murajaah Guide: How to Keep Your Quran Memorization with Quizzes
description: Practical steps for Quran revision with quizzes: start small, practice continuing the ayah, raise the difficulty, and review weak surahs.
h1: A guide to revision with quizzes
intro: Six simple steps to use Sambung Ayat as your daily revision companion.
1.p: Pick one juz or one short surah, for example Juz 30, and do 5 to 10 questions a day. Being consistent is more useful than an occasional long session.
2.p: The Continue the Ayah mode trains order: you must know which ayah comes next, not just recognize how it sounds.
3.p: The answer choices are drawn from similar, nearby ayahs, so you are forced to tell them apart instead of guessing from very different shapes.
4.p: The Identify the Ayah from Audio mode helps link sound to text. Save the audio if you want to practice without internet.
5.p: Open the History page. The surahs that most need revision appear at the top, with a Practice button on each row.
6.p: A quiz only measures recall. The correctness of your recitation and tajweed still needs to be heard in person by a teacher (talaqqi).
share: A guide to Quran memorization revision with quizzes
